formulas.selection: one asteroid per run, weighted by recipe weight, among recipes whose module tier <= the module's, minDistance <= distance <= maxDistance, and whose drone/drill/rod/voltage the module can satisfy
formulas.stacks: per parallel: minSize guaranteed draws, plus (maxSize - minSize) draws each kept with probability bonusChance/10000
formulas.draw: each draw picks ONE output, weighted by its chance among the recipe's outputs
formulas.time: plasmaTier > 0: duration * max(0.5, (1 - 0.1*(plasmaTier-1)) / overdrive); else duration
